season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Eighth Day
movement.line: The year is gathered, and the corners are left for the poor.

days.t: Rejoice in all the good the Lord has given
x: and thou shalt rejoice in all the good [things], which the Lord thy God has given thee, [thou] and thy family, and the Levite, and the stranger that is within thee.

days.t: You crown the year with your bounty
x: Thou wilt bless the crown of the year [because] of thy goodness; and thy plains shall be filled with fatness.

days.t: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation
x: Draw ye therefore water with joy out of the wells of salvation.

days.t: A great multitude from every nation
x: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no one was able to number it, out of every nation and [all] tribes and peoples and tongues standing before the throne and before the Lamb, having been clothed with white robes, and palm branches in their hands,
and crying out in a loud voice, saying: “Salvation to our God, the One sitting on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

days.t: The tabernacle of God is with men
x: And I heard a loud voice from the throne, saying: “Behold, the tabernacle of God [is] with men, and He will tabernacle with them, and they will be His peoples, and God Himself will be with them [as] their God.

days.t: Fasts turned to feasts of joy and gladness
x: Thus saith the Lord Almighty, The fourth fast, and the fifth fast, and the seventh fast, and the tenth fast, shall be to the house of Juda for joy and gladness, and for good feasts; and ye shall rejoice; and love ye the truth and peace.
